niosh.name: NIOSH Pocket Guide identity seed
niosh.role: authoritative chemical identity/exposure source; not sensor-response evidence

policy.m4_definition: HR069 device-specific reference-gas calibration/validation under a valid operating and heater protocol
policy.duplicate_curve_rule: Prefer the highest-provenance curve for the same sensor/analyte inside its declared domain. Do not arithmetic-average regression coefficients. If independent compatible sensor/source predictions are combined, combine concentration predictions in log10(ppm) space using evidence-weighted robust consensus.

evidence_rank.description: device-specific accepted reference-gas calibration; authoritative only when the operating envelope is valid
peer-reviewed datasheet graph fit or independent known-concentration experiment; external prior, not M4
classification/fingerprint/method evidence without transferable device quantitation

sources.title: Analisis Grafik Karakteristik Sensitivitas Sensor MQ-135 untuk Menentukan Persamaan Hubungan antara ppm dan Rs/Ro
sources.notes: Ten digitized points per analyte from the typical sensitivity graph; power regression in log-log space. Source itself states calibration against a standard gas instrument is still required for accurate measurement.

sources.title: Gas sensor array low-concentration
sources.notes: UCI explicitly describes these concentrations as below the sensors' minimum detection limit. Use for response-shape/classification evidence and method validation, not direct HR069 ppm transfer.

sources.title: A lightweight intelligent model for VOC mixture analysis: toward preclinical breath biomarker analysis
sources.notes: Pure acetone/ethanol/isopropanol and equimolar mixtures. Strong concentration-labelled external evidence; different array/circuit means transfer validation remains required.

sources.title: Visual smell fingerprinting with sensor arrays
sources.notes: Pure acetone and ethanol repeated measurements; uses response magnitude, slope and response ratios. Paper explicitly shows response rate is setup/diffusion dependent.

sources.title: Research on binary gas mixtures identification method: Humidity interference suppression using linear discriminant analysis
sources.transfer_constraint: HR069 currently uses a shared fixed 5 V MQ heater rail and cannot reproduce the published MQ3 dynamic temperature modulation.

sources.title: Bio-Inspired Swarm Navigation on Resource-Constrained Robots for GPS-Denied Environments
sources.notes: Voltage/log-linear model is platform-specific. Use for environmental-compensation design and corroboration, not direct Rs/R0 replacement.

sources.title: Winsen MQ-5 Semiconductor Sensor for Flammable Gas
sources.notes: Butane is a manufacturer qualitative sensitivity statement; HazRob must not invent a butane-specific Rs/R0 curve.
